note: v2482: prune.arm showed 0.916 < 0.839 under a correct verdict because the sign came from the lock state instead of the two numbers beside it; it is held by confluence, not by its score. And n=0 meant two different things: a door nobody has sabotaged yet, and vault.forget, which has no refusal path at all and never will. The distinction died twice on the way to the screen, once in the status whitelist and once in the renderer.
